expires.description: Expires is when this resource expires (RFC3339).

labels.description: Labels are arbitrary key/value pairs attached to the resource.

namespace.description: Namespace is the resource namespace (usually left blank).

revision.description: Revision is used for optimistic concurrency control.

spec.description: InferencePolicy resource definition v1 from Teleport

filter.description: Filter is an optional filter expression using Teleport Predicate Language to select sessions for summarization. If it's empty, all sessions that match the list of kinds will be summarized using this model.

kinds.description: Kinds are session kinds matched by this policy, e.g., "ssh", "k8s", "db"

model.description: Model is the name of the `InferenceModel` resource to be used for summarization.
